newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe building society lowers mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe building society lowers mortgage rates.

text.p: Zimbabwe's largest building society, the Central Africa Building Society (CABS), on Tuesday lowered its interest rates on mortgages by between 0.25 percent and 3.5 percent, citing falling market and bank lending rates.

In a statement, the bank said it had reduced to 19 percent from 19.75 percent its rates on existing residential mortgages of Z$45,000 or more while new loans for housing development would now attract a rate of 23.5 percent, down from 27 percent.
Existing and new industrial loans where the balance or the amount to be borrowed was less than Z$2.5 million would also attract 23.5 percent interest from 27 percent.
"The new interest rates are effective immediately for new loans and from December 1 for existing loans," CABS said.

Capital market officials and analysts were unavailable for comment as the announcement came after trading hours but Zimbabweans have been complaining for years that high interest rates were frustrating their efforts to own homes.
